outcome: exclusive breastfeeding at 4-5 months of age
mixed feeding at 4-5 months of age
cohort: The study included 5348 mothers with infants who participated in the FinChildren survey in Finland, categorized by their maternal origin.
finding: Somali-/Arabic-speaking mothers exhibited significantly lower rates of exclusive breastfeeding and higher rates of mixed feeding at 4-5 months of age compared to Russian- and native Finnish-speaking mothers, independent of sociodemographic and antenatal factors.
